sources.topic: Android Game Mode API, GameManager, and cmd game shell interventions
useful_patterns: GameManager.getGameMode() for runtime verification
cmd game mode [standard|performance|battery] <package> via shell/Shizuku
cmd game set --mode [2|3] --downscale [ratio] --fps [rate] <package>
dangerous_or_invalid_claims: Claiming GameManager.setGameMode() works for third-party packages without MANAGE_GAME_MODE privilege

sources.topic: Android Dynamic Performance Framework (ADPF) - PerformanceHintManager & Thermal APIs
useful_patterns: PerformanceHintManager.createHintSession(tids, targetDurationNanos)
reportActualWorkDuration(actualDurationNanos)
PowerManager.getCurrentThermalStatus() and OnThermalStatusChangedListener
PowerManager.getThermalHeadroom(forecastSeconds) on Android 12+
dangerous_or_invalid_claims: Claiming ADPF HintSession overrides hardware thermal shutdown thresholds

sources.topic: Shizuku Binder IPC, UserService, UID 2000 (shell) vs UID 0 (root) privilege boundaries
useful_patterns: Shizuku.pingBinder() before any binder invocation
Shizuku.checkSelfPermission() and OnRequestPermissionResultListener
OnBinderReceivedListener and OnBinderDeadListener for lifecycle resilience
Shizuku.getUid() == 0 (ROOT) vs 2000 (SHELL/ADB)
dangerous_or_invalid_claims: Treating Shizuku ADB mode as capable of writing root-owned 0644 sysfs nodes without root

sources.topic: Linux Kernel CPUFreq subsystem, policy directories, scaling governors, frequency tables
useful_patterns: Dynamic enumeration of policy0..policyN instead of per-core cpu0..cpuN writes
Validating target frequency against scaling_available_frequencies before writing
Reading back scaling_min_freq/scaling_max_freq to confirm kernel clamp behavior
dangerous_or_invalid_claims: Writing arbitrary integer frequencies not present in scaling_available_frequencies
Assuming userspace governor is available or safe on modern EAS (Energy Aware Scheduling) kernels

sources.topic: Linux Generic Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (devfreq) for GPU/DDR/Bus
useful_patterns: Enumerating /sys/class/devfreq/ entries dynamically rather than hardcoding kgsl-3d0 or mali
Checking file read/write accessibility before offering GPU frequency locks

sources.topic: Linux Thermal Sysfs ABI, thermal_zone*, cooling_device*, millidegree Celsius scaling
useful_patterns: Filtering thermal zones by type (cpu, gpu, battery, skin, soc, tsens) and dividing millidegrees by 1000.0
Never modifying trip_point temperatures or policy to disable thermal throttling
dangerous_or_invalid_claims: Writing 0 to /sys/module/msm_thermal/parameters/enabled or stopping thermal-engine daemon

sources.topic: Hardware-accurate FrameMetrics and Choreographer frame-time percentile telemetry
useful_patterns: Computing P50, P90, P95, P99 frame durations from TOTAL_DURATIONns
Using dumpsys SurfaceFlinger --latency <layer> when privileged shell is active for target app
Marking confidence level clearly (APP_WINDOW_CHOREOGRAPHER vs SURFACEFLINGER_SHELL vs UNAVAILABLE)
dangerous_or_invalid_claims: Generating random 118-120 FPS numbers when backgrounded without SurfaceFlinger access

sources.topic: Android task_profiles.json, cpusets, and sched_uclamp (uclamp.min / uclamp.max)
useful_patterns: Inspecting /dev/cpuctl/top-app/cpu.uclamp.min when root is available
Falling back to PerformanceHintManager on non-root devices
dangerous_or_invalid_claims: Moving system_server or surfaceflinger out of their assigned cpusets
